blocking.title: A landing recalled at sea after its first day splits: the one aboard is put ashore on the nearest home coast and marches to the old port for weeks while its partner lands alone; the map says it keeps its transports
blocking.fix: A recalled convoy of one sails back to its own landing's port (or on to the landing, to join its mates), not to the nearest port by straight cells; a recall that cannot rejoin is refused with that reason, and the mark agrees with the outcome. AT: seed 3517, the one sent alone to Fuzhou recalled to Shanghai at 1, 2, 3 and 5 days: it lands within a day of 365 each time, or is refused and told why.
